rules: All sprites in this pack use FLUX.2 Klein 9B FP8 and the common parameters below.
No mixing Pony trial artwork into the final pack.
Per-asset seeds and prompts are recorded in provenance, standard img2img denoise is 0.65; a localized broken-support structural edit uses 0.95, recorded in provenance.
Generation QA includes content, framing, alpha and alignment in the actual game.
Only generated artwork, alpha extraction, scaling, mirroring and palette variants. No drawn object overlays.
Changing the chosen model after production requires a new version and regeneration of the complete pack.
approval_scope: Owner accepted the complete playable static pack and boss fall on 2026-11-05, requesting furniture attacks enabled by default. Phase 4 accepted; phase 5 animation requires separate acceptance.
